faq.intro: The questions we get before every project, and our answers.

items.a: A website starts at $499, a logo at $200 and hosting at $35 per month. Every plan and what it includes is detailed on the {link}. If your project falls outside these plans, we give you a firm price after a free call.
items.aPricing: A website starts at $499, a logo at $200 and hosting at $35 per month. The exact inclusions of every plan are in the tables above. If your project falls outside these plans, we give you a firm price after a free consultation call.

items.q: How long does it take to build a site?
items.a: A Starter plan is online in 3 to 5 business days if your text and photos are ready. Growth and Enterprise plans take a few weeks, depending on the scope of the project.

items.q: I have no copy or photos.
items.a: It’s the most common situation. We guide you in preparing your text and photos, whatever the plan. Copywriting for your pages is included from the Signature plan and available on quote for the others.

items.q: I already have a website, but it’s weak. Do you rebuild it?
items.a: Yes, a rebuild is entirely possible. We start with a consultation to analyze your current site, then guide you through the whole rebuild process.

items.q: Will the site be in both French and English?
items.a: Yes, all our sites are built bilingual by default, so you can reach your entire customer base, whatever their language.

items.q: How will my customers reach me or book a meeting?
items.a: Your site offers several ways to reach you: form, email, phone and links to your social networks. Online booking is included from the Growth plan.

items.q: Will I be able to manage my blog myself?
items.a: Yes. The blog is designed so you can publish yourself, with no technical knowledge. It’s included from the Professional plan, with articles written for you for 12 or 24 months. If you prefer, we handle it.

items.q: Will the site rank well on Google?
items.a: Every site is built to SEO best practices: speed, mobile, page structure and local content. Google decides the final ranking, but your site starts on solid ground.

final.body: One consultation is enough to pin down your need. No commitment.
